property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract always reverts when passed an empty _tos array (i.e., it never returns successfully for _tos.length == 0); the mutant removes that require and can return true for empty arrays, violating this invariant.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to allow empty arrays (remove the require), so transfer can return true when _tos is empty whereas original reverts.
